scope: Initial twenty M3a service scenario groups, not full v0.5 parity. Local-unset compares the exact reference and Native on the same host; all named/configured zones use deterministic synthetic data.

zones.declarations:
import { Instant, TimeZone } from trb/std/time
import trb/std/result
def show_zone(name: String)
case TimeZone.try_get(name)
when Result::Ok(zone)
puts("ok|" + name + "|" + Instant.parse("2024-01-01T18:00:00Z").to_datetime(zone).to_s())
when Result::Err(error)
puts("err|" + name + "|" + error.message)
end
end

import trb/std/path
import trb/std/file
import { FileMode } from trb/std/file
import { FileSystemError } from trb/std/errors
import trb/std/unit
def replace_local(): Result<Unit, FileSystemError>
return File.open(Path.new("local.tzif"), mode: FileMode::Write) do |file|
try file.write("\x54\x5a\x69\x66\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01\x00\x00\x00\x05\x00\x00\x1c\x20\x00\x00\x54\x45\x53\x54\x00".to_bytes())
end
end
cache.body:
show_zone("Local")
case replace_local()
when Result::Ok(_value)
puts("replaced")
when Result::Err(error)
puts("write-error|" + error.message)
end
